extracted.name: Curry for all gravy dishes
extracted.description: This is the only simple solution to make any gravy curry recipes
instruction_lines: Put some oil or butter in pan and roast ginger+garlic+cumin seeds+cashews+cardamom+cloves+red hot pepper+fennel seeds
Roast for atleast 3 to 4 minute at low flame
Now add diced onion and roast until brown green chilli with tomato too separately
Add some butter or oil again in pan and add blended onion mixture
Now add all the spices and mix
Now add blended tomatoes and now stir it for atleast 15 minute
This is only curry or gravy you can preserve it and make any gravy veggie
